title: German Apple Tart
description: A sweet and crumbly tart filled with caramelized apples, perfect for a dessert or snack.

ingredients.name: Apples
ingredients.notes: Granny Smith or other tart variety

instructions: Roll out the German pastry dough to a thickness of 1/8 inch.
Transfer the dough to a 9-inch tart pan with a removable bottom.
In a large bowl, combine the sliced apples, brown sugar, cinnamon, and nutmeg. Mix until the apples are evenly coated.
Arrange the apple mixture in the tart shell, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Dot the top of the apple mixture with the butter.
Roll out the remaining pastry dough to a thickness of 1/8 inch. Use a pastry cutter or a knife to cut the dough into strips for a lattice-top crust.
Place the lattice strips on top of the apple mixture, weaving them into a lattice pattern.
Trim the edges of the lattice strips and press the edges of the lattice to seal.
Bake the tart for 40-50 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown and the apples are tender.
Remove the tart from the oven and let it cool on a wire rack for 10-15 minutes before serving.
